incident: Found while cleaning up that `brev delete` has no --yes flag, so every watchdog armed with it was a silent no-op. See the fix in brev/gate_launch.sh.
method: There is no quota command in the brev CLI (checked `brev --help` and `brev org`), so this is empirical: create one additional A6000 at a time alongside the running dev box and stop at the first refusal. A quota refusal fails the create call immediately rather than provisioning, so an instance reaching DEPLOYING means the create was accepted.
question: can this org run 4 A6000s at once
upper_bound_untested: Stopped at 4 because that was the question; 5 or more was not tried, so this is a lower bound rather than the quota itself.
